stem.en: One person carries a bag up a flight of stairs in 30 s. Another person carries the same bag up the same stairs in 90 s. Ignore the people's own weight. Which statement is correct?

text.en: The second does more work, because the climb takes longer.
Both do the same work, so both have the same power.
Both do the same work, and the first has three times the power.
The first does three times the work, because the climb is faster.

explanation.en: The work done on the bag is its weight x the height, the same for both. Power = work / time. The first person takes a third of the time, so the first person's power is three times as large.

hints.en: Does the time taken change the work done on the bag?
